entries.name: MWN109 injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a 760-participant Chinese Phase 3 study of once-weekly subcutaneous MWN109 for 52 weeks. The record remains not yet recruiting and its estimated 1 September 2026 start is not treated as first dosing. A separate 120-participant Phase 2 injection study is registry-completed with no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: Not-yet-recruiting Phase 3 registration is not trial initiation. Completed Phase 2 registry status does not establish efficacy because no results are posted.

entries.name: MWN110 injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry describes first-in-human single- and multiple-dose subcutaneous MWN110 research in healthy participants and people with overweight or obesity. It remains not yet recruiting with estimated enrolment of 103.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.

entries.name: TLC-6740 with tirzepatide
entries.summary: OrsoBio reported on 16 December 2025 that 55 adults with obesity completed a 24-week comparison of once-daily oral TLC-6740 plus low-dose tirzepatide versus tirzepatide alone. The broader registry record remains active, not recruiting and has no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for TLC-6740 or the combination.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Sponsor-reported research and registry activity do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: The findings are sponsor-reported, not registry-posted results. The planned larger Phase 2b study is not treated as started, and body-composition observations do not establish improved muscle strength or function.

entries.name: BIO101 / 20-hydroxyecdysone with semaglutide
entries.stage: Phase 2 approved in Brazil; sponsor says Q1 2027 start
entries.summary: Biophytis describes a 164-participant Phase 2 OBA study of oral BIO101 or placebo alongside semaglutide, focused on lower-limb muscle strength during weight loss and a later weight-regain assessment after semaglutide discontinuation.
entries.ukAuthorisation: Brazilian clinical-trial approval and the reviewed research evidence do not establish UK marketing authorisation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical-trial approval or registration does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: The registry remains not yet recruiting and still shows an older estimated July 2026 start; the sponsor's later 31 August 2026 update says first-patient enrolment is planned for Q1 2027. Neither date is treated as first dosing, and preclinical findings are not human efficacy evidence.
